scope: Source/AST review and earlier local SIGINT-inheritance experiment only; no VM, backend, benchmark or actual cancellation test
cleanup_changes: Wrapper explicitly resets SIGINT to Python default handler; wrapper SIGTERM raises KeyboardInterrupt; guarded child-wait cancellation/timeout sends SIGINT to unchanged campaign, allowing its finally cleanup
actual_stop_proof: Required for each attempt; source review is not a guarantee of live cleanup or complete monitor coverage

monitor.reads: PID, comm, starttime, utime/stime from /proc/<pid>/stat; no cmdline arguments
limitations: Endpoint deltas miss short-lived tasks and CPU before first/after last observed endpoint
Top20 only; no thread residency, affinity history, steal/throttling attribution or exact per-command overlap
No ready barrier before campaign launch; earliest startup coverage not guaranteed
Own /proc and JSON work can share host resources; low load/empty samples do not prove absence of interference
